title: Clean up a component animation
summary: A GSAP context can collect animations created for a component.
introduction: A GSAP context can collect animations created for a component. Your task: Find the call that reverts the GSAP context.
learningObjectives: Find the call that reverts the GSAP context.
Explain the example for clean up a component animation

blocks.text: A GSAP context can collect animations created for a component. Reverting it restores their styles and removes that animation work.
Use a browser project with GSAP 3 installed. Each example creates its own small box. Run one example at a time with a module build tool. GSAP is not loaded by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Clean up a component animation

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`to` moves from the current values toward the values you supply. GSAP duration values are in seconds.

blocks.text: Cleanup reverts the tween's changes before removing its box.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A removed page part should not leave running tweens behind. Keep cleanup with the feature that owns the animation.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Find the call that reverts the GSAP context.
